mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW_NOTIFICATION(USER_ID, ACTOR_ID, REVIEW_ID, TYPE) SELECT R.USER_ID, #{actorId}, R.REVIEW_ID, #{type} FROM REVIEW R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID JOIN USERS A ON A.USER_ID = #{actorId} WHERE R.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND R.USER_ID != #{actorId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.BAN_YN = 'N' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.BAN_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND READ_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW_NOTIFICATION SET READ_AT = COALESCE(READ_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ID = #{id}
